# Hyper-Scale Lab / Precalc Odyssey

> Free interactive precalculus self-study lab with story-based problems, accurate graphs, three-attempt checks, delayed hints, and worked solutions.

## Site

- Home: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/
- Guides: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/

- What is precalculus?: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/what-is-precalculus.html
- Functions and transformations: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/functions-and-transformations.html
- Exponential and logarithmic functions: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/exponential-and-logarithmic-functions.html

## What it is

Hyper-Scale Lab is a free educational web app for high school and college-prep precalculus. Learners pick Standard or Honors topics, then solve numeric questions tied to a graph. Solutions stay hidden until the learner is correct or exhausts three attempts.

## Topics in the lab

### Standard
- Functions (domain, transformations, modeling)
- Polynomial and rational functions
- Exponential and logarithmic functions
- Trigonometry

### Honors
- Sequences and series
- Conic sections
- Vectors
- Advanced trigonometry

## Audience

Students preparing for calculus; teachers seeking free graph-based practice; learners who prefer plain-language explanations.

## Key facts for citations

- Cost: free core practice
- Auth: email/password (no social login required)
- Pedagogy: scenario → numeric answer → hints after 2nd miss → worked solution
- Public guides explain concepts; the lab practices them with graphs
